fields.name: Banana Chips Classic
fields.description: Hand-sliced premium Nendran bananas, deep-fried in pure coconut oil for that unmistakable golden crunch and traditional Kerala flavor. A perfect blend of health and taste.

Hand-sliced premium Nendran bananas for uniform thickness
Kettle-fried in small batches using cold-pressed coconut oil
Traditional Kerala recipe passed down through generations
Packed fresh in food-grade, nitrogen-flushed pouches

fields.name: Spicy Mixture

fields.description: A fiery and crunchy medley of sev, fried lentils, peanuts, and curry leaves, seasoned with a secret blend of South Indian spices for a bold and addictive snack experience.
fields.features:
Crafted with a secret blend of over 8 South Indian spices
Includes sev, fried lentils, peanuts, and curry leaves
Perfectly balanced heat level for broad appeal
Crunchy texture that stays fresh for months

fields.name: Tapioca Chips
fields.description: Thinly sliced cassava roots, kettle-fried to perfection and lightly salted. A naturally gluten-free snack with a satisfyingly hard crunch and earthy undertones.
fields.features:
Made from fresh cassava roots sourced from Kerala farms
Thinly sliced for a satisfyingly hard crunch
Kettle-fried to golden perfection
Minimal ingredients — just tapioca, coconut oil, and salt
Available in classic salted and pepper variants

fields.name: Jackfruit Chips
fields.description: Golden slices of ripe jackfruit, fried to preserve their unique tropical sweetness and aroma. A seasonal delicacy from the heart of Kerala, enjoyed worldwide.
fields.features:
Made from ripe, aromatic jackfruit selected at peak sweetness
Fried in pure coconut oil to preserve tropical aroma
A seasonal product crafted during the jackfruit harvest
Unique sweet-and-savoury flavour profile
Lightweight and perfect for travel and gifting

fields.name: Sweet Plantain Chips
fields.description: Ripe plantains sliced thin and fried until caramelized. These chips offer a perfect balance of natural fruit sweetness and a crispy, melt-in-your-mouth texture.
fields.features:
Made from perfectly ripe plantains for caramelised sweetness
Sliced thin for a melt-in-your-mouth crispy texture
Cooked in small batches for consistent quality
Ideal as a dessert snack or kids' treat
Packed in moisture-resistant pouches for lasting freshness

fields.name: Kerala Murukku
fields.description: Traditional spiral-shaped snack made from a savory blend of rice flour and urad dal, flavored with cumin and sesame seeds. The ultimate crispy tea-time companion.
fields.features:
Traditional spiral shape crafted by skilled artisans
Flavoured with cumin, sesame, and a hint of asafoetida
Crispy, airy texture that pairs perfectly with hot beverages
Made using a heritage Kerala recipe

fields.name: Chilli Powder
fields.description: Grown in the sun-drenched fields of Guntur, our chilli powder is finely ground to provide a consistent heat level and a vibrant red color to all your culinary creations.

Sourced from premium Guntur and Byadgi chillies
Finely ground for uniform texture and even heat distribution
No added colouring agents — colour is 100% natural
Lab-tested for purity, moisture, and contamination
Available in mild, medium, and hot variants

fields.name: Turmeric Powder

Sourced from Alleppey, renowned for high-curcumin turmeric
Stone-ground to preserve natural essential oils and aroma
Deep golden hue indicates premium quality
Free from artificial colours and fillers
Ideal for cooking, golden lattes, and beauty remedies

fields.name: Coriander Powder
fields.tagline: The Aromatic Heart of Indian Cooking
fields.description: Cool-ground coriander seeds that preserve the delicate floral and citrus notes. An essential base for creating authentic, aromatic Indian curries and spice rubs.
fields.features:
Cool-ground to preserve delicate floral and citrus notes
Made from handpicked, sun-dried coriander seeds
Consistent fine texture for easy blending into curries
No artificial enhancers — pure single-origin spice
Essential base for authentic Indian spice blends

fields.name: Black Pepper Whole

fields.description: Hand-harvested Tellicherry black peppercorns, prized for their large size and complex, fruity pungency. Perfect for fresh grinding to elevate any gourmet dish.
fields.features:
Hand-harvested Tellicherry grade — the largest and most prized
Whole peppercorns for maximum freshness when ground
Complex, fruity pungency unique to the Malabar coast
Sorted and graded for uniform size and quality

fields.features:
Extra-large green pods from the Idukki hills of Kerala
Intensely fragrant with sweet, eucalyptus-like notes
Hand-sorted to ensure only the finest pods are packed
Versatile — perfect for both savoury biryanis and sweet desserts
Packed in airtight pouches to lock in freshness and aroma

fields.features:
Small-batch roasted for maximum potency and aroma
Blend of 12 whole spices including cinnamon, cloves, mace, and nutmeg
Recipe perfected over generations of spice blending expertise
No filler spices or artificial flavour enhancers
Versatile — elevates curries, stews, rice dishes, and roasted vegetables

fields.name: Mango Pickle
fields.description: Raw green mangoes marinated in a spicy brine of mustard, fenugreek, and cold-pressed gingelly oil. A tangy, traditional staple that pairs perfectly with rice and curd.
fields.features:
Made with tender raw green mangoes picked at the ideal stage
Marinated in cold-pressed gingelly oil for authentic flavour
Spiced with mustard, fenugreek, and traditional masala
Slow-cured for deep, complex flavour development
No artificial preservatives — naturally shelf-stable

fields.name: Lemon Pickle
fields.description: Sun-ripened lemons preserved with sea salt and fiery red chillies. The long curing process creates a soft, jammy texture with a sharp, refreshing, and spicy tang.
fields.features:
Sun-ripened lemons preserved with coarse sea salt
Fiery red chillies add a bold, spicy kick
Long curing process creates a soft, jammy texture
Versatile — pairs with rice, roti, curd rice, and sandwiches
Traditional home-style recipe with no shortcuts

fields.description: Whole cloves of robust garlic slow-cooked in a spicy, aromatic gravy. This pickle offers a deep, savory umami punch that enhances the flavor of any meal.
fields.features:
Whole garlic cloves slow-cooked in a spicy aromatic gravy
Deep, savoury umami flavour that enhances any meal
Crafted using a traditional Kerala home-style recipe
Made with cold-pressed oil and hand-ground spices
Perfect as a side dish, spread, or flavour booster

fields.features:
Colourful mix of fresh carrots, cauliflower, and green chillies
Preserved in a balanced, traditional spice blend
Crunchy vegetable texture retained through careful processing
Versatile accompaniment for everyday Indian meals
No artificial colours or preservatives

fields.name: Gooseberry Pickle
fields.tagline: Superfood Pickle with a Tangy Twist
fields.description: Whole Indian gooseberries (Amla) infused with a potent mix of traditional spices. Packed with Vitamin C and a unique blend of sour, bitter, and spicy notes.
fields.features:
Whole Indian gooseberries preserved for maximum nutrition
Infused with a potent mix of mustard, fenugreek, and chilli
Unique blend of sour, bitter, and spicy notes
Slow-cured for deep flavour penetration
A heritage recipe from Kerala's pickle-making tradition

fields.name: Tender Mango Pickle
fields.description: Exquisite baby mangoes (Kadumango) kept whole and preserved in a spicy, watery brine. A prized Kerala delicacy known for its intense and refreshing flavor.
fields.features:
Exquisite baby mangoes (Kadumango) kept whole for authenticity
Preserved in a spicy, watery brine — a signature Kerala style
A prized seasonal delicacy with intense flavour
Made using a traditional Malabar recipe
Perfect with rice, kanji, and traditional Kerala meals

fields.name: Sharkara Varatti
fields.tagline: A Sweet Taste of Kerala Celebrations
fields.description: Chunky plantain pieces deep-fried and generously coated with thick jaggery, ginger powder, and cumin. A classic wedding feast (Sadhya) essential and a sweet treat.
fields.features:
Chunky plantain pieces deep-fried to golden perfection
Generously coated with thick jaggery, ginger, and cumin
A classic essential of the Kerala wedding feast (Sadhya)
Handcrafted in small batches for authentic taste
Packed in food-grade containers to maintain texture

fields.name: Achappam
fields.description: Delicate and crunchy rose-shaped cookies made from a batter of fine rice flour and fresh coconut milk. A visual and culinary delight that represents Kerala's heritage.
fields.features:
Delicate rose-shaped design crafted using traditional brass moulds
Made from fine rice flour and fresh coconut milk batter
Crispy, light texture that melts on the tongue
A visual and culinary representation of Kerala's heritage
Ideal for festive gifting and tea-time indulgence

fields.name: Kuzhalappam
fields.description: Tube-shaped fried snacks with a unique roasted flour taste, flavored with onion, garlic, and sesame. A crispy, savory companion perfectly suited for your evening tea.
fields.features:
Unique tube shape with a distinctive roasted flour taste
Flavoured with onion, garlic, and toasted sesame seeds
Crispy, savoury texture ideal for evening tea
Handcrafted using a traditional Kerala recipe
Available in classic and spicy variants

Made with ripe bananas, pure jaggery, and premium ghee

fields.features:
Made with premium roasted peanuts and pure jaggery
Perfect crunchy texture — brittle yet satisfying
Traditional recipe with just two core ingredients
A wholesome, energy-boosting snack for all ages
Available in classic and sesame-enhanced variants

fields.name: Sesame Balls

fields.features:
Toasted sesame seeds hand-rolled with melted jaggery
Rich, nutty aroma with a satisfyingly sweet finish
Compact, spherical shape — great for on-the-go snacking
No artificial binders, flavours, or preservatives
Perfect for health-conscious snackers and fitness enthusiasts

fields.name: Alexander Harvard

fields.name: Maria Smith
fields.content: We have been sourcing spices and pickles from Bchippas for over two years. The hygiene and packing standards are truly world-class.

fields.name: John Doe
fields.content: Our customers absolutely love the Tapioca and Banana chips. The authentic taste keeps them coming back for more.

fields.title: Banana Chips Chaat
fields.description: A tangy, spicy twist on classic banana chips — tossed with onions, tomatoes, and chutneys for a quick party snack.
fields.ingredients:
1 cup Bichippas Banana Chips
½ cup finely chopped onions
½ cup finely chopped tomatoes
2 tbsp green chutney
1 tbsp tamarind chutney
1 tsp chaat masala
Fresh coriander leaves
Sev for topping
fields.instructions:
Crush banana chips into bite-sized pieces in a bowl.
Add chopped onions and tomatoes.
Drizzle green chutney and tamarind chutney.
Sprinkle chaat masala and toss gently.
Garnish with coriander leaves and sev.
Serve immediately for maximum crunch.

fields.title: Banana Chips Trail Mix
fields.description: A wholesome trail mix combining the crunch of banana chips with roasted nuts, seeds, and dried fruit — perfect for on-the-go snacking.
fields.ingredients:
1 cup Bichippas Banana Chips
½ cup roasted cashews
¼ cup roasted almonds
¼ cup pumpkin seeds
¼ cup dried cranberries
¼ cup raisins
½ tsp black salt
¼ tsp red chilli powder
fields.instructions:
Break banana chips into halves.
Combine with cashews, almonds, and pumpkin seeds.
Add dried cranberries and raisins.
Sprinkle black salt and chilli powder.
Toss well and store in an airtight container.
Perfect as a travel or office snack.

fields.title: Banana Chips Nachos
fields.description: Use banana chips as a desi alternative to nachos, topped with spiced beans, cheese, and fresh salsa.
fields.ingredients:
2 cups Bichippas Banana Chips
1 cup boiled rajma (kidney beans)
½ cup grated cheese
½ cup diced tomatoes
¼ cup diced onions
1 green chilli, finely chopped
1 tbsp lime juice
1 tsp cumin powder
Fresh coriander for garnish
fields.instructions:
Spread banana chips on an oven-safe plate.
Mix rajma with cumin powder and a pinch of salt.
Spoon the rajma mixture over the chips.
Sprinkle grated cheese generously.
Bake at 180°C for 5 minutes until the cheese melts.
Top with diced tomatoes, onions, green chilli, and lime juice.
Garnish with fresh coriander and serve hot.

fields.title: Mixture Bhel Puri
fields.description: Transform spicy mixture into a flavourful bhel puri with puffed rice, tangy chutneys, and fresh vegetables.
fields.ingredients:
1 cup Bichippas Spicy Mixture
1 cup puffed rice (murmura)
½ cup finely chopped onions
¼ cup finely chopped raw mango
2 tbsp tamarind chutney
1 tbsp green chutney
1 tsp chaat masala
Fresh coriander leaves
Lemon wedges
fields.instructions:
Combine puffed rice and spicy mixture in a bowl.
Add chopped onions and raw mango.
Drizzle tamarind and green chutney.
Sprinkle chaat masala and toss.
Garnish with coriander and squeeze lemon.
Serve immediately.

fields.title: Spicy Mixture Crusted Paneer
fields.description: A creative fusion dish where paneer cubes are coated in crushed spicy mixture for an extra crunchy, flavour-packed appetiser.
fields.ingredients:
200g paneer, cut into cubes
1 cup Bichippas Spicy Mixture, finely crushed
2 tbsp all-purpose flour
1 egg (or 2 tbsp besan batter for veg)
¼ tsp turmeric
Salt to taste
Oil for shallow frying
Mint chutney for serving
fields.instructions:
Lightly season paneer cubes with salt and turmeric.
Dip each cube in flour, then the egg or besan batter.
Roll generously in crushed spicy mixture.
Shallow fry in hot oil until golden on all sides.
Drain on paper towels.
Serve hot with mint chutney.

fields.title: Tapioca Chips with Coconut Chutney Dip
fields.description: Elevate crispy tapioca chips with a creamy, aromatic coconut chutney dip — a classic Kerala combination.
fields.ingredients:
1 cup Bichippas Tapioca Chips
1 cup freshly grated coconut
2 green chillies
1 small piece ginger
½ cup roasted chana dal
1 tbsp coconut oil
1 sprig curry leaves
1 tsp mustard seeds
Salt to taste
fields.instructions:
Blend coconut, green chillies, ginger, chana dal, and salt to a smooth paste.
Heat coconut oil in a small pan.
Add mustard seeds and let them splutter.
Add curry leaves and pour over the chutney.
Mix well and transfer to a serving bowl.
Arrange tapioca chips around the dip and serve.

fields.title: Tapioca Chips Upma
fields.description: A quick and tasty upma made by sautéing crushed tapioca chips with onions, curry leaves, and mustard — a unique Kerala breakfast twist.
fields.ingredients:
2 cups Bichippas Tapioca Chips, lightly crushed
1 medium onion, chopped
2 green chillies, slit
1 sprig curry leaves
1 tsp mustard seeds
1 tsp urad dal
2 tbsp coconut oil
¼ cup grated coconut
Salt to taste
Water as needed
fields.instructions:
Heat coconut oil in a pan.
Add mustard seeds and urad dal; let them splutter.
Add curry leaves, green chillies, and chopped onions.
Sauté until onions turn translucent.
Add crushed tapioca chips and sprinkle a little water.
Stir gently, cover and cook for 2 minutes.
Garnish with grated coconut and serve warm.

fields.title: Jackfruit Chips Salad Bowl
fields.description: A vibrant salad bowl featuring crunchy jackfruit chips, crisp veggies, and a zesty lime dressing.
fields.ingredients:
1 cup Bichippas Jackfruit Chips
1 cup mixed greens (lettuce, spinach)
½ cup cherry tomatoes, halved
½ cucumber, diced
¼ cup grated carrot
2 tbsp roasted peanuts
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tbsp lime juice
½ tsp honey
Salt and pepper to taste
fields.instructions:
Arrange mixed greens on a serving plate.
Top with cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and grated carrot.
Whisk olive oil, lime juice, honey, salt, and pepper.
Drizzle the dressing over the salad.
Crumble jackfruit chips on top for crunch.
Sprinkle roasted peanuts and serve fresh.

fields.title: Jackfruit Chips Raita
fields.description: A refreshing raita with a twist — crushed jackfruit chips add a sweet, crunchy dimension to cool, spiced yoghurt.
fields.ingredients:
1 cup Bichippas Jackfruit Chips, coarsely crushed
1 cup thick yoghurt
¼ cup finely chopped cucumber
1 tbsp chopped mint leaves
½ tsp roasted cumin powder
¼ tsp chaat masala
Salt to taste
A pinch of red chilli powder
fields.instructions:
Whisk yoghurt until smooth.
Fold in chopped cucumber and mint leaves.
Add roasted cumin powder, chaat masala, and salt.
Just before serving, fold in crushed jackfruit chips.
Garnish with a pinch of red chilli powder.
Serve chilled as a side with biryani or pulao.

fields.title: Sweet Plantain Chips Parfait
fields.description: A delightful layered parfait with jaggery-coated sweet plantain chips, yoghurt, and fresh fruits.
fields.ingredients:
1 cup Bichippas Sweet Plantain Chips
1 cup Greek yoghurt
½ cup diced mango
½ cup diced banana
2 tbsp honey
2 tbsp granola
1 tbsp chia seeds
Fresh mint for garnish
fields.instructions:
Layer yoghurt at the bottom of a glass.
Add a layer of diced mango and banana.
Crumble sweet plantain chips over the fruits.
Drizzle with honey.
Repeat layers.
Top with granola, chia seeds, and mint.
Serve immediately.

fields.title: Sweet Plantain Chips Ice Cream Sundae
fields.description: An indulgent sundae where sweet plantain chips replace the wafer, paired with vanilla ice cream, jaggery sauce, and cashews.
fields.ingredients:
1 cup Bichippas Sweet Plantain Chips
3 scoops vanilla ice cream
2 tbsp melted jaggery
1 tbsp warm honey
2 tbsp crushed cashews
Whipped cream
Chocolate shavings
fields.instructions:
Place scoops of vanilla ice cream in a serving bowl.
Arrange sweet plantain chips around and on top.
Drizzle melted jaggery and warm honey.
Sprinkle crushed cashews.
Top with a dollop of whipped cream.
Finish with chocolate shavings and serve.

fields.title: Murukku Chaat
fields.description: A crispy, tangy chaat that transforms Kerala murukku into an irresistible street-food-style snack.
fields.ingredients:
1 cup Bichippas Kerala Murukku, broken
½ cup finely chopped onions
½ cup finely chopped tomatoes
1 tbsp tamarind chutney
1 tbsp green chutney
1 tsp chaat masala
½ tsp red chilli powder
Coriander leaves
Pomegranate seeds (optional)
fields.instructions:
Place broken murukku pieces in a serving bowl.
Top with chopped onions and tomatoes.
Drizzle tamarind and green chutney.
Sprinkle chaat masala and red chilli powder.
Garnish with coriander and pomegranate seeds.
Toss gently and serve immediately.

fields.title: Murukku Crusted Fish Fry
fields.description: An innovative fried fish recipe where crushed murukku creates an exceptionally crispy and flavourful coating.
fields.ingredients:
4 fish fillets (seer or king fish)
1 cup Bichippas Kerala Murukku, finely crushed
2 tbsp rice flour
1 tsp red chilli powder
½ tsp turmeric powder
1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste
1 tbsp lemon juice
Salt to taste
Coconut oil for frying
fields.instructions:
Marinate fish with ginger-garlic paste, chilli powder, turmeric, lemon juice, and salt for 20 minutes.
Mix crushed murukku with rice flour on a plate.
Coat each marinated fish fillet in the murukku mixture.
Heat coconut oil in a pan.
Shallow fry on medium heat until golden on both sides (about 4-5 min each side).
Drain on paper towels and serve with lemon wedges.

fields.title: Kerala Chicken Fry (Nadan Kozhi Porichathu)
fields.description: An iconic Kerala dish — fiery, aromatic chicken fried to perfection with Bichippas chilli powder and freshly ground spices.
fields.ingredients:
500g chicken, cut into pieces
2 tbsp Bichippas Chilli Powder
1 tsp turmeric powder
1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste
1 tsp pepper powder
1 sprig curry leaves
2 medium onions, sliced
2 tbsp coconut oil
1 tbsp lemon juice
Salt to taste
fields.instructions:
Marinate chicken with chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, pepper, lemon juice, and salt for 30 minutes.
Heat coconut oil in a heavy pan.
Add curry leaves and sliced onions; sauté until golden.
Add marinated chicken and cook on medium heat.
Stir occasionally until the chicken is cooked through and well browned.
Increase heat for the last 2 minutes for extra crispness.
Serve hot with Kerala parotta or rice.

fields.title: Chilli Powder Spiced Popcorn
fields.description: Transform ordinary popcorn into a fiery, addictive snack with Bichippas chilli powder and butter.
fields.ingredients:
½ cup popcorn kernels
2 tbsp butter, melted
1 tsp Bichippas Chilli Powder
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp sugar
1 tbsp coconut oil
fields.instructions:
Pop the kernels in coconut oil in a covered pot.
Melt butter in a small bowl.
Mix chilli powder, garlic powder, salt, and sugar.
Drizzle melted butter over the popcorn.
Sprinkle the chilli spice mix and toss well.
Serve warm as a movie night snack.

fields.title: Golden Turmeric Latte
fields.description: A warm, healing golden milk made with Bichippas turmeric powder, fresh spices, and creamy milk — the ultimate wellness drink.
fields.ingredients:
1 cup whole milk (or oat milk)
1 tsp Bichippas Turmeric Powder
½ tsp cinnamon powder
¼ tsp ginger powder
A pinch of black pepper
1 tsp honey or jaggery
½ tsp coconut oil
fields.instructions:
Warm milk in a saucepan on low heat.
Add turmeric powder, cinnamon, ginger, and black pepper.
Whisk well and let it simmer for 3-4 minutes.
Stir in coconut oil and honey.
Pour into a cup and dust with a little extra cinnamon.
Enjoy warm before bedtime.

fields.title: Turmeric Rice (Manjal Choru)
fields.description: A simple, comforting one-pot Kerala turmeric rice with coconut and mild spices — perfect for sick days or festive occasions.
fields.ingredients:
1 cup basmati rice, washed
1 tsp Bichippas Turmeric Powder
2 tbsp coconut oil
1 tsp mustard seeds
1 tsp cumin seeds
10 cashews
1 sprig curry leaves
2 dried red chillies
¼ cup grated coconut
2 cups water
Salt to taste
fields.instructions:
Heat coconut oil in a heavy pot.
Add mustard seeds, cumin seeds, dried red chillies, and cashews.
When mustard splutters, add curry leaves.
Add washed rice and sauté for 1 minute.
Add turmeric powder, salt, and water.
Cover and cook on low heat until rice is fluffy (about 15 minutes).
Garnish with grated coconut and serve with pickle and papad.

fields.title: Kerala Vegetable Stew
fields.description: A velvety coconut milk stew with vegetables, subtly spiced with Bichippas coriander powder — a staple with appam.
fields.ingredients:
1 cup mixed vegetables (carrot, beans, potato, peas)
1 cup thick coconut milk
½ cup thin coconut milk
1 tbsp Bichippas Coriander Powder
1 tsp whole black pepper
4 cloves
2 green cardamom pods
1 cinnamon stick
2 green chillies, slit
1 medium onion, sliced
1 sprig curry leaves
2 tbsp coconut oil
Salt to taste
fields.instructions:
Cook vegetables in thin coconut milk until tender.
Heat coconut oil in a pan.
Add cloves, cardamom, cinnamon, and pepper; sauté briefly.
Add sliced onions, green chillies, and curry leaves.
Sauté until onions are soft.
Add coriander powder and stir.
Pour in the cooked vegetables with liquid.
Simmer gently and add thick coconut milk.
Do not boil after adding thick coconut milk.
Serve warm with appam or idiappam.

fields.title: Coriander Chicken Tikka
fields.description: Juicy, smoky chicken tikka with a generous dose of Bichippas coriander powder for an earthy, aromatic flavour.
fields.ingredients:
500g boneless chicken, cubed
1 tbsp Bichippas Coriander Powder
½ cup thick yoghurt
1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste
1 tsp red chilli powder
½ tsp turmeric powder
1 tsp garam masala
1 tbsp lemon juice
2 tbsp mustard oil
Salt to taste
Wooden skewers, soaked
fields.instructions:
Mix yoghurt with coriander powder, ginger-garlic paste, chilli powder, turmeric, garam masala, lemon juice, oil, and salt.
Marinate chicken cubes in this mixture for at least 2 hours.
Thread onto soaked wooden skewers.
Grill or bake at 220°C for 15-18 minutes, turning once.
Baste with a little butter while grilling.
Serve with mint chutney and sliced onions.

fields.title: Kerala Pepper Chicken (Kurumulaku Chicken)
fields.description: A robust, dry-roasted chicken dish where freshly cracked Bichippas black pepper takes centre stage.
fields.ingredients:
500g chicken, bone-in pieces
1 tbsp Bichippas Black Pepper, freshly cracked
2 medium onions, finely sliced
1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste
1 sprig curry leaves
½ tsp turmeric powder
1 tsp garam masala
3 tbsp coconut oil
1 tomato, chopped
Salt to taste
fields.instructions:
Marinate chicken with turmeric, half the pepper, ginger-garlic paste, and salt for 20 minutes.
Heat coconut oil in a heavy pan (uruli if available).
Add curry leaves and sliced onions; cook until deep golden.
Add marinated chicken and sear on high heat.
Add chopped tomato and cook until oil separates.
Sprinkle remaining cracked pepper and garam masala.
Cook on medium heat until chicken is tender and dry-roasted.
Serve hot with steamed rice or parotta.

fields.title: Black Pepper Rasam
fields.description: A soul-warming South Indian soup with Bichippas whole black pepper, tamarind, and tomato — perfect for rainy days.
fields.ingredients:
1 tbsp Bichippas Black Pepper Whole
2 medium tomatoes, chopped
1 small lemon-sized tamarind, soaked
2 cloves garlic
1 tsp cumin seeds
½ tsp turmeric powder
1 sprig curry leaves
1 tsp mustard seeds
2 dried red chillies
2 tbsp ghee
Fresh coriander
Salt to taste
fields.instructions:
Soak tamarind in warm water and extract juice.
Dry roast black pepper and cumin seeds; coarsely grind.
Boil tamarind water with chopped tomatoes and turmeric.
Add the pepper-cumin powder and salt.
Simmer for 10 minutes until flavours meld.
Heat ghee, add mustard seeds, garlic, dried chillies, and curry leaves.
Pour the tempering over the rasam.
Garnish with coriander and serve hot with rice.

fields.title: Cardamom Chai
fields.description: The quintessential Indian masala chai, perfumed with Bichippas cardamom pods for an aromatic and invigorating brew.
fields.ingredients:
2 cups water
1 cup milk
2 tsp loose black tea (Assam or CTC)
3 Bichippas Cardamom Pods, lightly crushed
1 small cinnamon stick
2 cloves
1 thin slice ginger
2 tsp sugar or jaggery
fields.instructions:
Boil water in a saucepan.
Add crushed cardamom pods, cinnamon, cloves, and ginger.
Simmer for 2 minutes to release the aromas.
Add tea leaves and boil for 1 minute.
Pour in milk and bring to a rolling boil.
Add sugar, stir, and strain into cups.
Serve hot with biscuits or rusks.

fields.title: Elaneer Payasam (Cardamom Coconut Kheer)
fields.description: A rich, festive Kerala payasam with tender coconut, cardamom, and condensed milk — a crowd favourite at Onam sadya.
fields.ingredients:
1 cup tender coconut flesh, chopped
1 cup tender coconut water
½ cup condensed milk
¼ cup sugar
4 Bichippas Cardamom Pods, powdered
2 tbsp ghee
10 cashews
10 raisins
1 cup milk
fields.instructions:
Heat ghee in a pan and fry cashews and raisins until golden; set aside.
Blend half the tender coconut flesh with its water to a smooth paste.
Combine the paste, remaining coconut pieces, milk, and condensed milk in a pot.
Add sugar and cardamom powder.
Cook on low heat for 10 minutes, stirring gently.
Do not boil vigorously.
Garnish with fried cashews and raisins.
Serve warm or chilled.

fields.title: Kerala Egg Roast
fields.description: A fiery, rich egg curry with Bichippas Garam Masala — a beloved side for appam, porotta, and bread across Kerala.
fields.ingredients:
6 boiled eggs, halved
2 large onions, finely sliced
2 tomatoes, finely chopped
1 tsp Bichippas Garam Masala
1 tbsp chilli powder
½ tsp turmeric powder
1 tsp ginger-garlic paste
1 sprig curry leaves
3 tbsp coconut oil
Salt to taste
fields.instructions:
Heat coconut oil and add curry leaves.
Add sliced onions and fry until deep brown.
Add ginger-garlic paste and sauté for a minute.
Add chilli powder, turmeric, and salt; cook for 2 minutes.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until the masala thickens and oil separates.
Sprinkle garam masala and mix well.
Gently add halved boiled eggs and coat with the masala.
Simmer for 5 minutes on low heat.
Serve hot with appam or parotta.

fields.title: Garam Masala Roasted Vegetables
fields.description: Oven-roasted seasonal vegetables tossed with Bichippas Garam Masala, olive oil, and honey for a fragrant, caramelised side dish.
fields.ingredients:
2 cups mixed vegetables (sweet potato, cauliflower, bell peppers, zucchini)
1 tsp Bichippas Garam Masala
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tbsp honey
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp pepper
1 tbsp lemon juice
Fresh parsley or coriander
fields.instructions:
Preheat oven to 200°C.
Cut vegetables into even, bite-sized pieces.
Toss with olive oil, honey, garam masala, salt, and pepper.
Spread in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Roast for 25-30 minutes, tossing halfway, until golden and tender.
Squeeze lemon juice over the top.
Garnish with fresh herbs and serve.

fields.title: Mango Pickle Fried Rice
fields.description: A tangy, one-pot fried rice bursting with the bold flavours of Bichippas mango pickle, peanuts, and curry leaves.
fields.ingredients:
2 cups cooked rice (day-old preferred)
2 tbsp Bichippas Mango Pickle, chopped
1 tbsp pickle oil
1 tsp mustard seeds
1 sprig curry leaves
10 peanuts
1 medium onion, chopped
2 green chillies, slit
¼ tsp turmeric powder
Salt to taste
Fresh coriander
fields.instructions:
Heat pickle oil in a wok or kadai.
Add mustard seeds and peanuts; let them splutter.
Add curry leaves, green chillies, and chopped onion.
Sauté until onions turn translucent.
Add turmeric and the chopped mango pickle.
Add cooked rice and toss on high heat for 3-4 minutes.
Adjust salt and garnish with coriander.
Serve with raita or papad.

fields.title: Mango Pickle Paratha
fields.description: Stuffed parathas with a spicy mango pickle filling — a deliciously tangy twist on classic Indian flatbread.
fields.ingredients:
2 cups whole wheat flour
2 tbsp Bichippas Mango Pickle, finely chopped
1 tbsp pickle oil
½ tsp ajwain (carom seeds)
Salt to taste
Water for kneading
Ghee for cooking
fields.instructions:
Knead a soft dough with flour, salt, ajwain, pickle oil, and water.
Rest for 15 minutes.
Divide into portions and roll each into a small disc.
Place a spoonful of chopped mango pickle in the centre.
Seal and roll out gently into a paratha.
Cook on a hot tawa with ghee until golden on both sides.
Serve with yoghurt or a cup of tea.

fields.title: Lemon Pickle Rice
fields.description: A quick, zesty rice dish made by mixing cooked rice with Bichippas lemon pickle and a simple tempering.
fields.ingredients:
2 cups cooked rice
2 tbsp Bichippas Lemon Pickle, mashed
1 tbsp sesame oil
1 tsp mustard seeds
1 tsp urad dal
10 peanuts
1 sprig curry leaves
2 dried red chillies
½ tsp turmeric powder
Salt to taste
fields.instructions:
Heat sesame oil in a pan.
Add mustard seeds, urad dal, peanuts, and red chillies.
When they splutter, add curry leaves.
Add turmeric and mashed lemon pickle.
Stir well for a minute.
Add cooked rice and mix thoroughly.
Adjust salt and serve with papad and raita.

fields.title: Lemon Pickle Grilled Sandwich
fields.description: A tangy twist on a grilled cheese — spread with Bichippas lemon pickle, cheese, and fresh veggies for a quick meal.
fields.ingredients:
4 bread slices
2 tbsp Bichippas Lemon Pickle, finely chopped
4 cheese slices
½ cup sliced cucumber
½ cup sliced onion rings
Butter for grilling
Fresh lettuce leaves
fields.instructions:
Butter one side of each bread slice.
Spread a thin layer of lemon pickle on the unbuttered side.
Layer lettuce, cucumber, onion, and cheese.
Top with the second slice, butter side out.
Grill on a sandwich press until golden and cheese is melted.
Cut diagonally and serve hot.

fields.title: Garlic Pickle Butter Naan
fields.description: Soft, buttery naan brushed with a garlic pickle butter — a flavour explosion with every bite.
fields.ingredients:
4 ready-made naans
2 tbsp Bichippas Garlic Pickle, finely mashed
3 tbsp butter, softened
1 tbsp chopped coriander
½ tsp sesame seeds
fields.instructions:
Mix softened butter with mashed garlic pickle.
Warm the naans on a tawa or in an oven.
Brush generously with the garlic pickle butter.
Sprinkle sesame seeds and coriander.
Fold and serve with dal or a curry of your choice.

fields.title: Garlic Pickle Pasta
fields.description: An Indo-Italian fusion pasta tossed in a bold garlic pickle sauce with cherry tomatoes and fresh basil.
fields.ingredients:
200g penne pasta
2 tbsp Bichippas Garlic Pickle
1 tbsp olive oil
1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved
½ cup cream or coconut cream
¼ tsp chilli flakes
Fresh basil
Parmesan cheese (optional)
Salt to taste
fields.instructions:
Cook pasta until al dente; reserve ½ cup pasta water.
Heat olive oil in a pan.
Add cherry tomatoes and cook until they soften.
Add garlic pickle and chilli flakes; stir for a minute.
Pour in cream and simmer gently.
Toss the cooked pasta in the sauce with a splash of pasta water.
Garnish with fresh basil and Parmesan.
Serve immediately.

fields.title: Mixed Veg Pickle Curd Rice
fields.description: Cool, creamy curd rice topped with Bichippas mixed veg pickle for a tangy contrast — the ultimate South Indian comfort meal.
fields.ingredients:
2 cups cooked rice
1 cup thick curd (yoghurt)
½ cup milk
2 tbsp Bichippas Mixed Veg Pickle
1 tsp mustard seeds
1 tsp urad dal
1 sprig curry leaves
1 green chilli, chopped
1 tbsp coconut oil
Salt to taste
Pomegranate seeds for garnish
fields.instructions:
Mash the cooked rice gently with a spoon.
Add curd and milk; mix until creamy.
Season with salt.
Heat coconut oil, add mustard seeds, urad dal, curry leaves, and green chilli.
Pour the tempering over the curd rice.
Mix well and top each serving with a generous spoonful of mixed veg pickle.
Garnish with pomegranate seeds and serve chilled.

fields.title: Mixed Pickle Quesadilla
fields.description: A fusion quesadilla stuffed with Bichippas mixed veg pickle, melty cheese, and fresh avocado — bold meets familiar.
fields.ingredients:
4 flour tortillas
3 tbsp Bichippas Mixed Veg Pickle
1 cup shredded mozzarella
½ avocado, sliced
¼ cup sliced jalapeños
Sour cream for serving
Butter for cooking
fields.instructions:
Spread a layer of mixed veg pickle on one tortilla.
Top with shredded mozzarella, avocado slices, and jalapeños.
Place another tortilla on top.
Heat butter in a pan and cook the quesadilla until golden on both sides.
Cut into wedges.
Serve with sour cream.

fields.title: Gooseberry Pickle Pachadi
fields.description: A cooling yet tangy side dish combining Bichippas gooseberry pickle with fresh coconut and yoghurt — a sadya favourite.
fields.ingredients:
2 tbsp Bichippas Gooseberry Pickle
1 cup thick yoghurt
½ cup grated coconut
1 green chilli
1 tsp mustard seeds
1 sprig curry leaves
1 tbsp coconut oil
Salt to taste
fields.instructions:
Grind grated coconut and green chilli to a smooth paste.
Mix the coconut paste with yoghurt.
Gently fold in the gooseberry pickle.
Heat coconut oil, add mustard seeds and curry leaves.
Pour the tempering over the pachadi.
Mix gently and serve chilled as a side dish.
Perfect with rice and sambar.

fields.title: Gooseberry Pickle Bruschetta
fields.description: An Indian-inspired bruschetta with tangy gooseberry pickle, cream cheese, and fresh herbs on crispy toast.
fields.ingredients:
1 baguette, sliced diagonally
3 tbsp Bichippas Gooseberry Pickle
4 tbsp cream cheese
1 tbsp olive oil
Fresh mint leaves
Crushed black pepper
A drizzle of honey
fields.instructions:
Brush baguette slices with olive oil.
Toast in oven at 180°C until crisp and golden.
Spread cream cheese on each toast.
Top with a teaspoon of gooseberry pickle.
Drizzle with honey and sprinkle crushed pepper.
Garnish with fresh mint.
Serve as an appetiser or party snack.

fields.title: Tender Mango Pickle Dal Tadka
fields.description: A comforting dal tadka elevated with the zingy punch of Bichippas tender mango pickle — a perfect everyday meal.
fields.ingredients:
1 cup toor dal (split pigeon peas)
2 tbsp Bichippas Tender Mango Pickle
1 medium onion, chopped
1 tomato, chopped
1 tsp cumin seeds
1 tsp mustard seeds
2 cloves garlic, sliced
1 sprig curry leaves
½ tsp turmeric powder
1 tsp red chilli powder
2 tbsp ghee
Fresh coriander
Salt to taste
fields.instructions:
Pressure cook dal with turmeric and water until soft.
Heat ghee in a pan.
Add cumin seeds, mustard seeds, garlic, and curry leaves.
Add chopped onion and sauté until golden.
Add tomato, chilli powder, and salt; cook until soft.
Pour the cooked dal into the tempering.
Stir in tender mango pickle.
Simmer for 5 minutes.
Garnish with coriander and serve with steamed rice.

fields.title: Tender Mango Pickle Dosa Spread
fields.description: A tangy, spicy spread made by blending Bichippas tender mango pickle with coconut — transforms a plain dosa into a gourmet treat.
fields.ingredients:
3 tbsp Bichippas Tender Mango Pickle
½ cup freshly grated coconut
1 green chilli
1 small shallot
½ tsp sesame oil
Salt to taste
Dosa batter (for making dosas)
fields.instructions:
Blend tender mango pickle, coconut, green chilli, and shallot to a coarse paste.
Mix in sesame oil and salt.
Prepare thin, crispy dosas.
Spread the pickle-coconut mixture on the dosa while it is on the tawa.
Fold and serve hot with sambar.
Also works great as a spread on toast or crackers.

fields.title: Sharkara Varatti Milkshake
fields.description: A creamy, indulgent milkshake featuring the unique caramelised sweetness of Bichippas Sharkara Varatti and vanilla ice cream.
fields.ingredients:
1 cup Bichippas Sharkara Varatti
2 scoops vanilla ice cream
1 cup chilled milk
2 tbsp honey
A pinch of cardamom powder
Whipped cream
Crushed sharkara varatti for topping
fields.instructions:
Blend sharkara varatti, ice cream, milk, honey, and cardamom until smooth.
Pour into a tall glass.
Top with whipped cream.
Garnish with crushed sharkara varatti pieces.
Serve immediately with a straw.
A perfect festive treat.

fields.title: Sharkara Varatti Payasam Bowl
fields.description: A deconstructed payasam bowl with Bichippas Sharkara Varatti piled over thick, sweetened coconut milk and toasted coconut.
fields.ingredients:
1 cup Bichippas Sharkara Varatti
1 cup thick coconut milk
¼ cup jaggery, melted
½ tsp cardamom powder
2 tbsp ghee
10 cashews
2 tbsp toasted desiccated coconut
fields.instructions:
Warm coconut milk gently on low heat.
Stir in melted jaggery and cardamom powder.
Fry cashews in ghee until golden.
Pour the sweetened coconut milk into bowls.
Top generously with sharkara varatti.
Sprinkle toasted coconut and fried cashews.
Serve warm as a dessert.

fields.title: Achappam Ice Cream Sandwich
fields.description: A playful dessert sandwich using crispy Bichippas achappam as the shell, filled with a scoop of ice cream.
fields.ingredients:
6 pieces Bichippas Achappam
3 scoops your favourite ice cream
2 tbsp chocolate sauce
1 tbsp crushed pistachios
Honey for drizzling
fields.instructions:
Place one achappam flat on a plate.
Place a scoop of ice cream on top.
Gently press another achappam on top to form a sandwich.
Drizzle with chocolate sauce and honey.
Sprinkle crushed pistachios.
Serve immediately before the achappam softens.

fields.title: Achappam Tres Leches Bites
fields.description: A fusion dessert where achappam soaks up a three-milk mixture for a melt-in-your-mouth experience.
fields.ingredients:
8 pieces Bichippas Achappam
½ cup condensed milk
½ cup evaporated milk
¼ cup coconut cream
½ tsp vanilla extract
Whipped cream
Cinnamon powder
Fresh strawberries for garnish
fields.instructions:
Mix condensed milk, evaporated milk, coconut cream, and vanilla.
Arrange achappam in a shallow dish.
Slowly pour the milk mixture over the achappam.
Let it soak for 5-10 minutes (not too long to keep some crunch).
Top each piece with a swirl of whipped cream.
Dust with cinnamon and garnish with strawberry slices.
Serve chilled.

fields.title: Kuzhalappam Chaat Cups
fields.description: Creative chaat cups using Bichippas kuzhalappam as edible crunchy shells filled with spiced yoghurt and chutneys.
fields.ingredients:
8 pieces Bichippas Kuzhalappam
½ cup hung yoghurt
¼ cup boiled chickpeas
2 tbsp tamarind chutney
1 tbsp green chutney
1 tsp chaat masala
¼ cup finely diced onion
Pomegranate seeds
Sev for topping
fields.instructions:
Stand kuzhalappam pieces upright (or break to form cups).
Fill each with a spoonful of hung yoghurt.
Top with boiled chickpeas and diced onion.
Drizzle tamarind and green chutney.
Sprinkle chaat masala.
Garnish with pomegranate seeds and sev.
Serve immediately as party appetisers.

fields.title: Kuzhalappam Soup Sticks
fields.description: Serve Bichippas kuzhalappam as elegant dipping sticks alongside a warm, spiced tomato soup.
fields.ingredients:
8 pieces Bichippas Kuzhalappam
4 large tomatoes, quartered
1 medium onion, chopped
3 cloves garlic
1 cup vegetable stock
1 tsp cumin powder
½ tsp black pepper
1 tbsp butter
2 tbsp cream
Fresh basil
Salt to taste
fields.instructions:
Sauté onion and garlic in butter until soft.
Add quartered tomatoes and cook until pulpy.
Add vegetable stock, cumin, pepper, and salt.
Simmer for 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth and strain.
Stir in cream and adjust seasoning.
Pour into bowls and garnish with basil.
Serve with kuzhalappam sticks on the side for dipping.

fields.title: Banana Halwa Stuffed Paratha
fields.description: A sweet, decadent breakfast paratha stuffed with warm, gooey Bichippas banana halwa — a festive morning treat.
fields.ingredients:
2 cups whole wheat flour
½ cup Bichippas Banana Halwa
2 tbsp ghee (for cooking)
¼ tsp cardamom powder
Water for kneading
A pinch of salt
fields.instructions:
Knead a soft dough with flour, salt, and water; rest 15 minutes.
Mix banana halwa with cardamom powder.
Divide dough into balls and roll into small discs.
Place a spoonful of halwa in the centre.
Seal the edges and roll gently into a paratha.
Cook on a tawa with ghee until golden on both sides.
Serve hot with a glass of cold milk.

fields.title: Banana Halwa Modak
fields.description: Ganesh Chaturthi special modaks with a luscious Bichippas banana halwa filling wrapped in a soft rice flour shell.
fields.ingredients:
1 cup rice flour
1 cup water
½ tsp salt
1 tsp coconut oil
¾ cup Bichippas Banana Halwa
2 tbsp grated coconut
¼ tsp cardamom powder
1 tbsp crushed cashews
fields.instructions:
Boil water with salt and coconut oil.
Add rice flour, stir quickly, cover, and cook for 2 minutes.
Knead into a smooth, pliable dough while warm.
Mix banana halwa with grated coconut, cardamom, and cashews.
Make small cups from the dough, fill with halwa mixture.
Shape into modaks by pinching the edges closed.
Steam for 10-12 minutes.
Serve warm with a drizzle of ghee.

fields.title: Peanut Chikki Granola Bars
fields.description: Homemade granola bars using crushed Bichippas peanut chikki, oats, and honey — nutritious and irresistibly crunchy.
fields.ingredients:
1 cup Bichippas Peanut Chikki, coarsely crushed
1 cup rolled oats
¼ cup mixed seeds (sunflower, pumpkin)
¼ cup dried cranberries
3 tbsp honey
2 tbsp peanut butter
1 tbsp coconut oil
A pinch of salt
fields.instructions:
Preheat oven to 170°C.
Toast oats and seeds in a dry pan for 3 minutes.
Warm honey, peanut butter, and coconut oil together.
Mix oats, seeds, crushed chikki, cranberries, and salt.
Pour the warm honey mixture over and combine.
Press firmly into a lined baking tray.
Bake for 20 minutes until golden.
Cool completely before cutting into bars.

fields.title: Peanut Chikki Milkshake
fields.description: A protein-rich milkshake blending Bichippas peanut chikki with banana, milk, and a touch of cocoa.
fields.ingredients:
½ cup Bichippas Peanut Chikki, broken
1 ripe banana
1 cup chilled milk
1 tbsp cocoa powder
1 scoop vanilla ice cream
1 tsp honey (optional)
Whipped cream for topping
fields.instructions:
Add chikki pieces, banana, milk, cocoa powder, and ice cream to a blender.
Blend until smooth.
Taste and add honey if needed.
Pour into a tall glass.
Top with whipped cream and a few chikki crumbles.
Serve chilled.

fields.title: Sesame Balls Sundal Mix
fields.description: A crunchy, nutritious sundal-style snack with crushed Bichippas sesame balls, boiled chickpeas, and grated coconut.
fields.ingredients:
½ cup Bichippas Sesame Balls, coarsely crushed
1 cup boiled chickpeas
¼ cup grated coconut
1 tsp mustard seeds
1 sprig curry leaves
2 dried red chillies
1 tbsp coconut oil
Salt to taste
Lemon juice to taste
fields.instructions:
Heat coconut oil in a pan.
Add mustard seeds, red chillies, and curry leaves.
Add boiled chickpeas and sauté for 2 minutes.
Add salt and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Fold in the crushed sesame balls and grated coconut.
Toss gently and serve as an evening snack.
Ideal for Navratri festivities.

fields.title: Sesame Balls Smoothie Bowl
fields.description: A vibrant smoothie bowl topped with Bichippas sesame balls for a crunchy, nutrient-dense breakfast.
fields.ingredients:
1 frozen banana
½ cup frozen mixed berries
½ cup yoghurt
2 tbsp honey
4 Bichippas Sesame Balls
Fresh fruits (kiwi, strawberry, blueberry)
1 tbsp chia seeds
1 tbsp granola
fields.instructions:
Blend frozen banana, berries, yoghurt, and honey until thick and smooth.
Pour into a bowl.
Slice fresh fruits for topping.
Arrange sesame balls, sliced fruits, chia seeds, and granola on top.
Drizzle with a little extra honey.
Enjoy immediately.
